data.narrative:
GHGSat is a Series D-stage space technology company that has raised $67M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across two applicable methods within a comparable universe of 4 private peers in Space & Aerospace at the same or adjacent funding stage, supplemented by a public comp set of 5 tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) that anchor sector multiples.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier to a $500M total-raised proxy, implying a $750M valuation. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B, Series C), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.9B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable because GHGSat's revenue is not available; the sector median P/S multiple is 26.4x across 6 public tickers, but cannot be applied without revenue data.

The triangulated valuation range is $638M (low), $1.3B (median), and $2.2B (high), derived from two methods. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations—driven partly by stage heterogeneity and business-model differences—and the absence of revenue metrics to cross-check against public market multiples. Stage progression conservatively anchors the floor; peer medians suggest mid-point fair value closer to $1.3B.
